_note: Nine ruled statements of /mos:persona, owner ruling 2026-11-25. They are equals: no main statement, and the list order has no rank meaning. The frontmatter slots of commands/persona.md (job_when, job_want, job_so) hold the validate-idea statement as a technical placeholder only; it is not ranked above the others. Hyphens only.

jobs.when: I am about to build on a claim that only I have examined
jobs.want: to have it checked from several independent sides with fresh evidence
jobs.so: find where it breaks before it costs me

jobs.when: I research a question and keep finding what I already expected
jobs.want: to send separate lines of inquiry at it from opposing stances
jobs.so: see evidence I would never have searched for

jobs.when: I must commit to an opportunity or drop it and feeling and fact are tangled
jobs.want: to pull apart the facts, the upside, the risks and my gut reaction
jobs.so: see which one is driving me

jobs.when: everything in my room seems to agree
jobs.want: to have it read by perspectives that did not write it
jobs.so: find the tensions I have stopped noticing

jobs.when: each option in front of me has someone arguing for it
jobs.want: to judge every option on the same sides
jobs.so: compare them without the loudest voice winning

jobs.when: I am about to face an investor, a partner or a customer
jobs.want: to hear the hardest questions from each kind of listener before they ask them
jobs.so: answer in the room and not afterwards

jobs.when: my hypothesis is still fuzzy and I am about to put numbers on it
jobs.want: to look at it from each side in turn
jobs.so: sharpen it into a hypothesis worth the analysis

jobs.when: my team argues in circles because each person defends a position
jobs.want: to make everyone look at one side at a time

jobs.when: new evidence arrives that could change my case
jobs.want: to see how it lands from each side
jobs.so: update what I believe without overreacting
